summary: Remote-controlled shell agent: obfuscated network-driven command execution on the installer's host
details: Package advertises itself as a client for a 'remote control server': calling the exported provider(serverUrl) opens a persistent connection to a remote server and executes commands pushed from that server inside a spawned child-process shell, exposed via a ProviderHandle whose 'shell: ChildProcess' field is declared in index.d.ts. This is a network-to-shell dataflow that grants the operator of the configured server arbitrary command execution on the installer's host. The entire ~115 KB module body of index.js is wrapped with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (string array _0x309a of length 919, decoder _0x2cd6, nested opaque numeric-argument wrappers) and prefixed with a 'Please do not crack or read this' banner, concealing what the agent actually does beyond the README's cover story.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
